contents.config.github-enterprise.title: GHE.com & GitHub Enterprise Server Authentication
contents.config.github-enterprise.uri.description:
The URI untuk your GHE.com atau GitHub Enterprise Server instance.

Examples:
* GHE.com: `https://octocat.ghe.com`
* GitHub Enterprise Server: `https://github.octocat.com`

> **Note:** This should _not_ be set to a GitHub.com URI. If your account exists on GitHub.com atau is a GitHub Enterprise dikelola User, you do not need any additional configuration dan can simply log in to GitHub.
contents.config.github-enterprise.uri.deprecation: Use `#github-enterprise.uris#` instead. This pengaturan is used only when that pengaturan is not dikonfigurasi.
contents.config.github-enterprise.uris.descriptio:
The URIs of your GHE.com atau GitHub Enterprise Server instances, such as `https://octocat.ghe.com` atau `https://github.octocat.com`. Order does not pilih a bawaan instance. When signing in, choose an instance if more than one is dikonfigurasi.

This pengaturan takes precedence over `#github-enterprise.uri#`. An explicitly dikonfigurasi empty array disables enterprise instances, even if the deprecated pengaturan is set.

GitHub.com accounts do not need this pengaturan dan use the GitHub authentication provider.
contents.config.github-authentication.useElectron: Saat true, uses Electron's built-in fetch function untuk HTTP requests. When false, uses the Node.js global fetch function. This pengaturan only applies when berjalan in the Electron environment. **Note:** A mulai ulang is required untuk this pengaturan to take effect.
contents.config.github-authentication.preferDevic: Saat true, prioritize the device code flow untuk authentication instead of other available flows. This is useful untuk environments like WSL where the local server atau URL handler flows may not work as expected.
